$comment: Which apps run an older version than their newest release: updates.json from update-status.sh (prdsrv1, every six hours), served by Caddy on the proxy network only.
name: Updates
description: Apps behind their newest release (same major, from ./update.sh) and new major versions, from check-updates.sh every six hours.
templateLines: <Paper px="sm" py="xs" radius="md" h="100%" style={{ minWidth: 0, display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", justifyContent: "center", gap: 6, overflow: "hidden" }}>

<ThemeIcon variant="light" radius="md" size="lg" color={status.updates?.ok === false || !data.updates?.checked ? "gray" : data.updates.behind > 0 ? "orange" : data.updates.majors > 0 ? "yellow" : "green"}><TablerIcon name={status.updates?.ok === false || !data.updates?.checked ? "alert-triangle" : data.updates.behind > 0 ? "circle-arrow-up" : "circle-check"} size={20} /></ThemeIcon>

<Text size="sm" fw={600} truncate>{status.updates?.ok === false || !data.updates?.checked ? "Update check not readable" : data.updates.behind > 0 ? `${data.updates.behind} ${data.updates.behind === 1 ? "app" : "apps"} behind` : "Everything up to date"}</Text>
{(data.updates?.images ?? []).filter((i, n, all) => (i.update || i.major) && all.findIndex((j) => j.app === i.app && j.update === i.update && j.major === i.major) === n).map((i) => (
<Badge size="sm" variant="light" tt="none" color={i.update ? "orange" : "yellow"} style={{ flexShrink: 0 }}>{i.update ? `${i.pinned} → ${i.update}` : `major ${i.major}`}</Badge>

{data.updates?.behind > 0 ? <Text size="xs" c="dimmed">On the Mac: homelab-apps ./update.sh</Text> : data.updates?.majors > 0 ? <Text size="xs" c="dimmed">New major: read its notes, then ./update.sh app=version</Text> : null}
